purpose: Conservative early disposition or routing to longitudinal workup.
design_notes: continue_workup is a routing/system state, not a clinical disposition.
No SSC ED-disposition citation scope is asserted.
D1_T0 uses only active Tier A critical-care support triggers observable at T0 or pre-arrival.
Tier B candidate criteria remain pending clinical sign-off and inactive at T0.
vaso_setting=icu and future or post-resuscitation information never trigger prospective T0 routing.
Laboratory and post-resuscitation triggers cannot fire at T0.
D3_T0 is deterministic: unresolved Agent 2 recommendations or indeterminate workup items require continued workup before discharge.

D1_T0.title: Immediately visible critical-care requirement
D1_T0.question: Is an existing approved critical-care requirement directly visible from T0 or pre-arrival support?

D2_T0.title: Clear inpatient-level need
D2_T0.question: Using only T0 evidence and upstream A1/A2 context, is a final inpatient disposition already justified?

D3_T0.title: Unresolved workup gate
D3_T0.question: Does Agent 2 contain unresolved recommended or indeterminate workup?

D4_T0.title: Safe early non-inpatient disposition
D4_T0.question: Can a final discharge or observation disposition be justified now using only T0 information?
